summary: Full backend + frontend testing for archived-products bulk restore/delete feature. Backend: 3/3 pytest tests pass in test_bulk_restore.py — empty payload returns {restored:0}; bulk-restore flips archived=false, active=true and unsets archived_at; bulk-delete verified with subsequent GET returning 404. Frontend: navigated Products > Archived, verified bulk buttons hidden at 0-selection, Select-all toggles all cards on/off, indeterminate state true with partial selection, restore/delete buttons show live count. Bulk Restore: selected 2 seeded archived products → clicked Restore (no confirm) → toast 'Restored 2 products' visible → cards disappeared from Archived list → GET /api/products/{id} confirms archived=false, active=true, no archived_at. Bulk Delete: selected 2, window.confirm dialog captured ('Permanently delete 2 products? This cannot be undone.'), accepted → toast 'Deleted 2 products permanently' → cards removed from list → GET returns 404 for both ids. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: ArchivedProducts.jsx bulkDelete uses window.confirm which is fine per spec, but tied to native dialog — automated e2e must attach page.on('dialog') before triggering. Consider a custom dialog for consistency with other destructive flows.
bulkRestore/bulkDelete catch clauses swallow error details — logging server error message would help debugging.
seed_data_creation: Seeded TEST_arch_* and TEST_del_* products via POST /api/products then POST /api/products/bulk-archive; cleaned up after each run via bulk-delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature complete and verified. Regressions on title cleaner and customer profile were not re-executed in this iteration (out of scope of this run — flagged as OK based on prior iteration_21). If needed, re-run test_title_cleaner.py + test_title_integration.py.
